title: Final Answer for k
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that k = m*omega^2.

title: Equation of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct equation of motion for the small body in the lab frame.

title: Velocity Expressions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for dot{x} and dot{y} as functions of time.

title: Position Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expressions for x(t) and y(t) based on the initial conditions.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a clear description or sketch of the motion of the body on the turntable.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as sign errors in the equations of motion.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the problem.
